questions.questionText:
Hospital services are provided by the government and paid for through taxation. People cannot
always get the treatment they require because of long waiting lists.
Of what is this an example?

options.text: external cost
market system
perfectly inelastic supply
scarcity

questions.questionText: Who determines what goods and services are produced in a market economy?

options.text: consumers
employees
government
trade unions

questions.questionText:
In 2015, the world price of oil fell rapidly due to changes in the conditions of demand and supply.
One change was the use of a new method of extraction called fracking.
Which event would not have contributed to the fall in prices?

options.text: China’s growth slowed leading to lower oil imports.
Saudi Arabia increased the volume of its oil supplies.
UK protest groups prevented the introduction of fracking projects.
USA became more self-sufficient in oil due to fracking and reduced imports.

questions.questionText: What is a function of a country’s stock exchange?

options.text: to act as lender of last resort to commercial banks
to provide a market for the purchase and sale of shares
to provide short-term loans for investment
to set interest rates within the country

questions.questionText: What might cause an increase in the earnings of a doctor in a government health service?

options.text: an increasing number of doctors graduate from university each year
an increasing number of people need health care
the government spends less on the nation’s health services
the population becomes more aware of healthy eating

questions.questionText:
What would put a trade union in a strong bargaining position to negotiate higher wages for its
members in a particular firm?

options.text: The demand for the product produced by the workers has an inelastic demand.
The economy is experiencing high unemployment.
The proportion of the firm’s workers in the union is low.
Wage costs are a high proportion of total costs for firms in the industry.

questions.questionText:
What is most likely to encourage the immediate purchase of an expensive item such as a new
car?

options.text: anticipating a fall in the rate of inflation
expecting interest rates to fall
making it easier to obtain a loan
needing to plan for unexpected emergencies

It must be paid even if output is zero.

questions.questionText: What is most likely to be an example of a progressive tax?

options.text: customs duties on imported goods
excise duties on cigarettes
income tax
sales tax

questions.questionText: When is a government said to balance its budget?

options.text: when all goods and services are taxed equally
when economic growth is the same in all regions of the economy
when its total income equals its total expenditure
when total exports equal total imports

questions.questionText:
In which case is success for the government in achieving the first aim likely to cause problems in
achieving the second?
first aim second aim

options.text: full employment price stability
high economic growth full employment
price stability stable balance of payments
stable balance of payments more even distribution of income

questions.questionText: When is a recession said to occur?

options.text: Economic growth in the economy falls for at least two consecutive quarters.
Gross domestic product (GDP) falls for at least two consecutive quarters.
The current account of the balance of payment is in deficit for at least two consecutive quarters.
The government experiences a budget deficit for at least two consecutive quarters.

questions.questionText:
Developing countries are sometimes given aid by charities and foreign governments.
Which aid programme would be least likely to lead to long-term economic growth?

options.text: the building of an irrigation system
the construction of a new airport
the distribution of gifts of food
the training of technical staff

country.
Which term is given to this limitation?

options.text: ban
embargo
quota
tariff

questions.questionText:
What is most likely to happen if South Korea builds a factory in Switzerland that becomes
profitable?

options.text: South Korea’s imports of goods will decrease.
South Korea’s investment income will increase.
Switzerland’s trade balance in goods will worsen.
Switzerland’s trade balance in services will improve.
